This is the first skill quest for [[Mesmer]] characters. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | profession = mesmer | primary = y | test = n }} ===Objectives=== * Follow the road southwest until you find skale. Clear the road of skale. * Return to Sebedoh the Mesmer for your reward. ===Reward=== * 500 [[Experience]] * 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * {{skill icon|Empathy}} * {{skill icon|Ether Feast}} ===Environmental changes=== * After completing the quest: :*[[Haversdan]] appears in front of the gate to [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]], while Sebedoh leaves and can no longer be found pre-[[Searing]]. :* The 4 [[River Skale Tad]]s will no longer spawn on the road. Instead, creatures around the river will begin spawning as normal, with different low-level skale as well as [[devourer]]s appearing in the eastern section of [[Lakeside County]]. ==Walkthrough== Follow the road southwest until you come upon the 4 skale. Killing either of the two closest to the city triggers the rest of the pack to start fleeing toward the river, completing the quest condition. Killing either of the other two has no effect on the quest and does not trigger any reaction from the remaining skale, but is a quick source of a little extra XP. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{me}} [[Sebedoh the Mesmer]] ===Foes=== [[Skale]] *{{e}} 0 [[River Skale Tad]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Sebedoh the Mesmer :''"Before I teach you any skills, I want to know that you are up to the task."'' :''"Hie thee to the '''river road''' and clear out the irksome '''skale horde''' that's hanging about.
